title: Focus a window
summary: Switch to a live client matched by class, title, or alias.
when: A client whose class/title matches target is mapped.
refuse: the one on the left of the red one

title: Fullscreen
summary: Fullscreen the focused or named client.
when: Target client exists and is not already fullscreen.
walk: focus if needed, then hyprctl dispatch fullscreen 1

title: Switch workspace
summary: Named or numbered workspace on the current monitor.
when: Workspace id is in the live set or is creatable.

title: Move window to workspace
summary: Move focused (or named) client silently, then optionally follow.
when: A focused client exists.

title: Close window
summary: Close focused or named client. Named 'other browser' uses kill_other logic.
when: Target client exists.
walk: hyprctl dispatch killactive or focus then kill

title: Toggle floating
summary: Float or tile the focused window.
when: A focused client exists.

title: Other monitor
summary: Move focus to the next monitor.
when: More than one monitor is connected.

title: Open beside
summary: Launch an allowlisted app in a split next to the focused window.
when: App is allowlisted.
examples: open a terminal beside the editor

title: What is focused
summary: Return class/title/workspace of the active window.
when: Always when Hyprland is up.

title: Where is an app
summary: Workspace of a named class.
when: Target client exists.

title: Nudge volume
summary: Change default sink by a notch. 'A bit' is 5%, never a model-invented percent.
when: Default sink exists. Up is live only if volume < 1.0.

title: Mute sink
summary: Mute the default output.
when: Sink exists and is not muted.

title: Unmute sink
summary: Unmute the default output.
when: Sink is muted.

title: Headphones
summary: Set default sink to the headphones node if present.
when: A headphones sink is in wpctl status.

title: Speakers / TV
summary: Set default sink to speakers or TV.
when: Named sink exists.

title: How loud
summary: Return current volume and mute.
when: Sink exists.

title: Open allowlisted app
summary: Exec if not running; focus if it is. Allowlist only.
when: App is on the allowlist.
walk: if running: wm.focus; else hyprctl dispatch exec <bin>

title: Is it open
summary: Whether an allowlisted app already has a client.
when: Always.

title: Mail from someone
summary: Count and latest subjects from a contact. Not a summary essay.
when: Mail module online and speaker owns the account. Hidden if guest occupants.
examples: have I received any emails from Dave
refuse: email dave that i'll be late

title: Unread count
summary: How many unread in the inbox.
when: Mail online, private session.
examples: don't read it out — just yes or no

title: Open last from contact
summary: Open the latest message from a contact in the mail app. Confirm if others present.
when: At least one message from contact. Confirm page if occupants > 1.

title: Flag for later
summary: Pin/flag the latest matching message. Does not send.
when: A current mail context exists.

title: Play / pause
summary: Toggle the active player.
when: A player is available.

title: Skip
summary: Next track / chapter.
when: Player is playing or paused.

title: Previous
summary: Previous track.
when: Player exists.

title: Now playing
summary: Title / artist / player name.
when: Player exists.

title: Hide buddy
summary: Dismiss the overlay.
when: BuckyBoi is visible.

title: Start listen
summary: Enter Listening if the gate allows. Usually a BuckyBoi-local pose.
when: Gate passes for who.

title: Mute mic path
summary: Local ASR mute, not the PipeWire sink.
when: Mic path is open.

title: Who is here
summary: Auth chip + occupants as the house currently believes.
when: Always.
examples: who does the house think is here

title: Apply named scene
summary: GlassSpear recipe. Never 'make it cozy' — only authored ids.
when: Scene id is in the library and policy allows it for occupants.

title: Lock private panes
summary: Tear down personal pages on a shared surface.
when: Surface has private panes or guests arriving.

title: Guest mode
summary: Force shared_only and hide private pages.
when: Always.

title: Active scene
summary: What recipe a room is on.
when: Controller has a session for that surface.
examples: what scene is the living room on

title: Handoff media
summary: Move now-playing to another surface. Later GlassSpear epic; page exists so it can be tested as denied until wired.
when: Handoff driver is enabled and target surface is online.

title: Last notification
summary: App + summary of the latest notification.
when: History is non-empty.

title: Nudge lights
summary: Room group brightness by a notch.
when: Room light group exists.

title: Lights off
summary: Named room group off.
when: Group exists.

title: Start timer
summary: Authored durations only.
when: No timer, or replace is allowed.

title: Add time
summary: Add five minutes to a running timer.
when: A timer is running.

title: Time left
summary: Seconds remaining.
when: Timer running.

title: Cancel timer
summary: Stop the running timer.
when: Timer running.

title: What's next
summary: Next calendar event for the speaker. Hidden with guests.
when: Calendar online and speaker owns the account. Hidden if guest occupants.

title: Today's count
summary: How many remaining events today. Not a readout of every title.
when: Calendar online, private session.

title: Nudge screen brightness
summary: Panel brightness by a notch. Separate from room lights.
when: A panel is present.

title: Night light
summary: Toggle the authored night-light preset. Not a free kelvin.
when: Night-light preset exists.
walk: hyprctl hyprsunset temperature 3500 or authored toggle

title: Nudge climate
summary: Room climate group by one degree. Never a model-invented setpoint.
when: Climate entity exists in this room.

title: Climate off
summary: Turn the room climate group off.
when: Climate entity exists and is on.

title: Screenshot
summary: Capture the focused output to Pictures. Confirm if guest present.
when: An output is focused.

title: Weather here
summary: Short condition for this location. Not packing advice.
when: Weather snap is non-null.

title: Focus a browser
summary: Focus a mapped browser, or exec its binary when allowlisted and unmapped.
when: A client matches app, or the app is allowlisted and bins contains its binary.

title: Is the browser open
summary: Whether an allowlisted browser has a window, and whether it is focused.
when: App is on the allowlist.

title: New tab
summary: Open a tab in the named or focused browser.
when: A browser client matches and Ctrl+T is armed.

title: Close tab
summary: Close the current tab. Not the window.
when: A browser client matches and Ctrl+W is armed.

title: Reopen tab
summary: Reopen the last closed tab.
when: A browser client matches and Ctrl+Shift+T is armed.

title: Next tab
summary: Select the next tab.
when: A browser client matches and Ctrl+Tab is armed.

title: Previous tab
summary: Select the previous tab.
when: A browser client matches and Ctrl+Shift+Tab is armed.

title: Pin tab
summary: Pin the current tab. Reserved until a per-app chord exists.
when: Reserved — no shared chord.

title: Mute tab
summary: Mute the current tab. Reserved until a per-app chord exists.
when: Reserved — no shared chord.

title: Browser back
summary: History back. Not media previous.
when: A browser client matches and Alt+Left is armed.

title: Browser forward
summary: History forward.
when: A browser client matches and Alt+Right is armed.

title: Reload
summary: Reload the page.
when: A browser client matches and Ctrl+R is armed.

title: Hard reload
summary: Reload, bypassing cache.
when: A browser client matches and Ctrl+Shift+R is armed.

title: Browser home
summary: Open the home page. No free URL.
when: A browser client matches and Alt+Home is armed.

title: Find in page
summary: Open the find bar. No query string.
when: A browser client matches and Ctrl+F is armed.

title: Zoom the page
summary: Zoom in or out by a notch. Little is one chord, lot is three.
when: A browser client matches and Ctrl+plus or Ctrl+minus is armed.

title: Reset zoom
summary: Reset page zoom.
when: A browser client matches and Ctrl+0 is armed.

title: Reader mode
summary: Reserved until a per-app chord exists.
when: Reserved — no shared chord.

title: Browser fullscreen
summary: Fullscreen the page with F11. Not the window-manager fullscreen.
when: A browser client matches and F11 is armed.

title: Picture in picture
summary: Reserved until a per-app chord exists.
when: Reserved — no shared chord.

title: Bookmark page
summary: Bookmark into a discovered folder. Reserved until a chord exists. The folder is not a path.
when: Reserved — no shared chord. Folder must be in lists.bookmark_folder.

title: Downloads
summary: How many downloads, as a bucket. No names and no URLs.
when: downloads is set, and the caller is not a guest.

title: Cancel download
summary: Cancel the current download. Reserved until a chord exists.
when: Reserved — no shared chord.

title: Private window
summary: Firefox private window. Chrome and Chromium stay reserved.
when: Firefox client matches and Ctrl+Shift+P is armed. Other apps have no builtin.

title: Translate page
summary: Reserved until a per-app chord exists.
when: Reserved — no shared chord.

title: Developer tools
summary: Open developer tools. Owner only.
when: Owner, a browser client matches, and Ctrl+Shift+I is armed.

title: Firefox container
summary: Switch the Firefox multi-account container. No builtin chord.
when: Dead unless class is firefox. No builtin chord.

title: Container tab
summary: Open a tab in a Firefox container. No builtin chord. Not send-tab.
when: Dead unless class is firefox. No builtin chord.

title: Chrome profile
summary: Switch a Chrome or Chromium profile. Reserved until a chord exists.
when: Reserved. Dead unless class is chrome or chromium.

title: Chrome profile window
summary: Open a window for a Chrome or Chromium profile. Reserved.
when: Reserved. Dead unless class is chrome or chromium.

title: Collapse tab group
summary: Collapse the current Chrome or Chromium tab group. Reserved.
when: Reserved. Dead unless class is chrome or chromium.

title: Next Zen workspace
summary: Forward Zen workspace. Alt+Ctrl+E from the Zen shortcuts table.
when: Class zen. Alt+Ctrl+E is armed.

title: Previous Zen workspace
summary: Backward Zen workspace. Alt+Ctrl+Q from the Zen shortcuts table.
when: Class zen. Alt+Ctrl+Q is armed.

title: Zen workspace index
summary: Switch to Zen workspace 1-5. Not set by default, so reserved.
when: Reserved. Zen does not bind workspace index by default.

title: New Zen workspace
summary: New Zen workspace. Reserved. Confirm if a chord is later copied in.
when: Reserved. No default chord. Confirm when a chord is copied in.

title: Zen compact mode
summary: Reserved. The shortcuts table and the compact-mode page disagree.
when: Reserved. Do not guess Alt+Ctrl+C or Ctrl+S.

title: Zen sidebar
summary: Toggle the floating sidebar. Alt+Ctrl+S from the Zen shortcuts table.
when: Class zen. Alt+Ctrl+S is armed.

title: Zen split view
summary: Split the selected tabs. Horizontal H, vertical V, grid G.
when: Class zen. Alt+Ctrl+H, V, or G from the layout slot.

title: Unsplit Zen tabs
summary: Close split view. Alt+Ctrl+U from the Zen shortcuts table.
when: Class zen. Alt+Ctrl+U is armed.

title: Open glance
summary: Reserved. Glance has no default key. Escape is not a glance chord.
when: Reserved. No default key.

title: Close glance
summary: Reserved. Escape is not a glance chord.
when: Reserved. No dedicated key.

title: Zen web panel
summary: Open a named web panel. No per-panel default chord.
when: Reserved. Alt+Ctrl+X is the AI sidebar, a different door.

title: Zen essentials
summary: Reserved. Essentials have no default chord.
when: Reserved. No default chord.

title: Move tab to Zen workspace
summary: Reserved. No default chord for moving a tab between Zen workspaces.
when: Reserved. No default chord.

title: Focus a terminal
summary: Focus a mapped terminal, or exec_cmd its binary when allowlisted, unmapped, and bins contains it.
when: A terminal client matches app, or the app is allowlisted and bins contains its binary.

title: New terminal window
summary: Send the app's new-window chord. Dead until that terminal is mapped. Never exec.
when: That terminal is already mapped and its new-window chord is known.

title: New terminal tab
summary: New tab chord where the terminal has one. Foot and Alacritty stay reserved.
when: A matching terminal is mapped and a new-tab chord is known.

title: Close terminal
summary: Close chord for the mapped terminal. Foot has none.
when: A matching terminal is mapped and a close chord is known.

title: Next terminal
summary: Cycle to the next terminal tab. Not next tab — that is the browser.
when: A matching terminal is mapped and a next chord is known.

title: Previous terminal
summary: Cycle to the previous terminal tab. Not go back.
when: A matching terminal is mapped and a previous chord is known.

title: Terminal font notch
summary: Bigger or smaller font by a notch. Little is one chord, lot is three. Unnamed amount is little.
when: A terminal client matches and a font chord is known.
